lore.common: Stays on last month's page until someone notices in the middle of the next one.
lore.uncommon: Has a little ring drawn round every birthday, so nobody can pretend they forgot.
lore.rare: Shuffles its own dates, so the dentist appointment keeps landing on the trip to the zoo.
lore.epic: Double-booked the whole family for one Saturday, and they went to a wedding, a football match and a party in the same clothes.
lore.legendary: Crossed out Monday so firmly that the whole office took the day off, and nobody has worked out how to undo it.

names.legendary: The Page That Made It Friday

lore.common: Gets torn off a day early by someone who can't wait for the weekend.
lore.uncommon: Curls up at the corner like a little dog's ear.
lore.rare: Tears itself off at midnight, so everyone wakes up a day ahead.
lore.epic: Was torn off so fast before the holiday that the whole office snowed with paper days.
lore.legendary: Tore itself off five times in one night, and the whole school arrived for the summer holidays on a Tuesday in spring.

lore.common: Snaps its clip on your fingers every time you add a new sheet.
lore.uncommon: Has a list with little ticks on it that never quite gets finished.
lore.rare: Makes whoever holds it look so important that doors open and nobody asks questions.
lore.epic: Was carried round the school by a pupil for one afternoon, and three teachers tidied their desks just in case.
lore.legendary: Walked a lost tourist into the town hall meeting, and the tourist ended up chairing it.

lore.common: Has a little lock that pops open if you just look at it hard enough.
lore.uncommon: Has a tiny key that vanishes the night you most need it.
lore.rare: Falls open at the most embarrassing page whenever a brother walks past.
lore.epic: Was read aloud at the sleepover by mistake, and five friendships were fixed by morning.
lore.legendary: Kept a secret for forty years, then was found by a granddaughter who wrote the next page.

lore.common: Sheds a sheet of paper every time it's lifted.
lore.uncommon: Has a label on its tab that doesn't match what's inside.
lore.rare: Hides important papers in the wrong drawer and then looks innocent.
lore.epic: Was pulled from the bottom of the stack, and the whole filing cabinet fell over like a waterfall of paper.
lore.legendary: Hid the same lost form for ten years, then turned up the day after it was no longer needed.

names.legendary: The Fattest Folder in Year Six

lore.common: Snaps its elastic band on your thumb when you close it.
lore.uncommon: Bulges with so many worksheets that it won't close properly.
lore.rare: Swallows the homework you need and spits out the one from last term.
lore.epic: Burst open on the bus, and every worksheet from the whole year flew out of the window.
lore.legendary: Held every worksheet from one whole school year and was entered into the school museum.

names.legendary: The Journal That Found the Waterfall

lore.common: Gets doodles in every margin before a single real word is written.
lore.uncommon: Has a soft leather cover that gets nicer every time it's held.
lore.rare: Wrote down an idea at midnight that its owner didn't remember having.
lore.epic: Was left open in the rain, and every page became a watercolour painting.
lore.legendary: Held the notes of an explorer who found a hidden waterfall, with the map drawn on page four.

names.legendary: The Notebook That Passed Every Test

lore.common: Tangles its spiral in your jumper sleeve.
lore.uncommon: Always runs out of pages one line before the end of the lesson.
lore.rare: Rips out pages so neatly that it leaves no fringe, and nobody believes it.
lore.epic: Was copied from by the whole class on the night before the exam, and the photocopier gave up.
lore.legendary: Was revised from by three brothers in a row, and all three got top marks.

lore.common: Gets covered in doodles every time someone is on the phone.
lore.uncommon: Has the shopping list on it, but always stays at home on the kitchen counter.
lore.rare: Writes messages so messily that "call Gran" becomes "cool gorilla".
lore.epic: Mixed up the family's messages so badly that the plumber was invited to Sunday lunch.
lore.legendary: Wrote down a phone number that won the family a holiday, and is now kept in a frame.

lore.common: Is coloured in with twelve different pens before a single plan is made.
lore.uncommon: Plans so many things in one day that there's no time for lunch.
lore.rare: Squeezes an extra hour into every Saturday, and the clocks are still trying to work out where it came from.
lore.epic: Planned a family holiday so tightly that they saw nine castles and no beaches.
lore.legendary: Planned a whole wedding to the minute, and the bride arrived exactly as the bells rang.

lore.common: Pinches your fingers every time its rings snap shut.
lore.uncommon: Rips the holes in every sheet so the pages hang loose.
lore.rare: Grows a new coloured divider overnight, until nobody can find maths.
lore.epic: Snapped open at the bottom of the stairs and spread a whole year of coursework from the hall to the kitchen.
lore.legendary: Held every lesson from a whole school career, and the student who owned it became a teacher.

names.legendary: The Note That Ran the House

lore.common: Falls off the wall as soon as you read it.
lore.uncommon: Covers the fridge door so thickly that the fridge looks yellow.
lore.rare: Multiplies overnight, so one reminder on the fridge becomes forty by breakfast.
lore.epic: Covered every window in the office for a joke, and the boss thought it was a sunny day.
lore.legendary: Reminded a whole family to do everything for a month until the house ran itself.

names.legendary: The Bookcase That Opened a Room

lore.common: Wobbles when you take a book out from the bottom.
lore.uncommon: Sags in the middle under the heaviest books.
lore.rare: Swings open like a secret door when the right book is tilted.
lore.epic: Tipped one book over, then another, and the whole library fell like dominoes.
lore.legendary: Revealed a hidden room behind it that held a lost tea set, a cat and a very old piano.

lore.common: Goes soggy at the corner the moment it touches a puddle.
lore.uncommon: Is turned into a fort with windows and a door by every child who finds it.
lore.rare: Becomes the fastest sledge on the hill whenever it snows.
lore.epic: Was made into a whole cardboard city in the garden, and the cat moved into the town hall.
lore.legendary: Built a castle so tall in the living room that the family ate dinner in its great hall for a week.

lore.common: Comes out wonky and lopsided every time someone tries to fold it.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its paper wings when you pull its tail.
lore.rare: Grants a tiny wish to whoever folds it perfectly, or so its owner believes.
lore.epic: Was folded a thousand times by a whole school, and the string of cranes went round the playground.
lore.legendary: Was folded by a grandad for each day his granddaughter was in hospital, and she came home to a sky of them.

names.legendary: The Letter That Found Its Way

lore.common: Gives you a paper cut every time you open it in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Has a sticky edge that tastes terrible when you lick it.
lore.rare: Has a little window that shows exactly who it's from, so you know it's a bill.
lore.epic: Arrived with five hundred others on the same birthday, and the doormat disappeared.
lore.legendary: Was posted forty years ago, lost behind a sorting machine, and arrived on the right birthday anyway.

names.legendary: The Sign That Renamed the Street

lore.common: Has been spelt wrong for thirty years, and nobody can be bothered to fix it.
lore.uncommon: Gets stickers on it every week, and the council peels them off every Monday.
lore.rare: Twists in the wind until it points down the wrong road.
lore.epic: Was turned round at the crossroads, and every delivery van in town spent the day in a cul-de-sac.
lore.legendary: Was misspelt so long that the town gave up and changed the street's name to match it.

names.legendary: The Atlas That Planned Every Holiday

lore.common: Is so heavy that it squashes your legs flat when you read it on your lap.
lore.uncommon: Has a fold-out page that never folds back the same way.
lore.rare: Opens on a random country whenever it's dropped, and its owner wants to go there.
lore.epic: Was opened on every desk in the geography lesson, and the whole class planned a trip to the same island.
lore.legendary: Planned fifty holidays for one family by falling open on the right page each summer.

names.legendary: The Map With an Extra X

lore.common: Can never be folded back the way it came out of the shop.
lore.uncommon: Is always held upside down by the person in charge.
lore.rare: Shows a path that doesn't exist, and somehow everyone finds it anyway.
lore.epic: Led a whole walking group the wrong way round a lake, and they found the best tea shop in the county.
lore.legendary: Had an X drawn on it by a grandad as a joke, and his grandchildren dug up a real tin of old coins.

lore.common: Leaves grey ink on everyone's fingers and on the white sofa.
lore.uncommon: Gets its crossword done in pen by grandad before anyone else can try.
lore.rare: Flies off the bench on a windy day and wraps itself round a passing cyclist.
lore.epic: Blew out of every paper box in the street on the windiest Sunday, and the whole town wore headlines.
lore.legendary: Printed a story about a lost dog on Monday, and by Tuesday the dog had read it and come home.

names.legendary: The Machine That Stitched a Town

lore.common: Snarls its thread into a bird's nest under the fabric.
lore.uncommon: Is driven by a foot pedal that its owner presses like a racing car.
lore.rare: Stitched a hem so fast that the curtain was finished before the kettle boiled.
lore.epic: Made every costume for the school play in one week, including a dragon and a talking teapot.
lore.legendary: Stitched a patchwork quilt so big that it covered the whole village green for the summer fair.

names.legendary: The Puncher That Made It Snow

lore.common: Spills its little paper circles all over the floor when you open it.
lore.uncommon: Jams if you put more than three sheets in it.
lore.rare: Punches holes slightly off-centre, so every page hangs crooked.
lore.epic: Was emptied out of the office window for a joke, and the car park looked like it had snowed.
lore.legendary: Punched enough paper circles for a whole wedding's confetti, and saved the bride buying any.

lore.common: Labels the light switch, the door and the dog's bowl.
lore.uncommon: Prints every label with a typo, so the jar says SUGRA.
lore.rare: Sticks its label so firmly that it never comes off, even in the dishwasher.
lore.epic: Labelled everything in the kitchen in one afternoon, including the kettle, the toaster and Dad.
lore.legendary: Labelled every shelf in the giant library so well that a lost book was found after fifty years.

lore.common: Snaps its little jaws like a crocodile on your fingers.
lore.uncommon: Pinches the paper and tears a corner off along with the staple.
lore.rare: Rescues pages from staples so neatly that the holes vanish.
lore.epic: Freed every page from a mountain of stapled reports, and the office looked like a paper snowstorm.
lore.legendary: Unstapled a thousand reports in one afternoon and was given a little crown made of staples.

names.legendary: The Tape Gun That Taped the Van

lore.common: Screeches so loudly when it's pulled that everyone covers their ears.
lore.uncommon: Seals a box in one long noisy swoop.
lore.rare: Finds the end of the tape every time, which no human can do.
lore.epic: Sealed every box on moving day so well that nobody could open them for a week.
lore.legendary: Taped a whole van shut by mistake, with the moving men still inside eating sandwiches.

lore.common: Gets folded and refolded so many times that the face on it looks like it's winking.
lore.uncommon: Gets folded so small that it disappears in the wallet.
lore.rare: Turns up in old coat pockets just when someone needs it most.
lore.epic: Blew down the high street on a windy day, and twenty people chased it.
lore.legendary: Was spent at the market, travelled the country for ten years, and came back to its owner in change.

lore.common: Sags in the middle so the words read WELC... OME.
lore.uncommon: Fills with wind like a sail and tries to fly away.
lore.rare: Flapped its welcome message so loudly that the guests arrived early.
lore.epic: Was hung across the whole street for the party, and every lorry had to drive under it on tiptoe.
lore.legendary: Was blown away in a gale and landed across the finish line of a marathon, just in time.

lore.common: Has pages so thin that they stick together and tear if you rush.
lore.uncommon: Is so heavy that it needs two hands and a table.
lore.rare: Has every family birthday from a hundred years ago written in the front cover.
lore.epic: Fell off the top shelf during spring cleaning and shook every ornament in the room.
lore.legendary: Held the names of seven generations in its front pages, and the newest baby was added this year.
